$description: Material (dark appearance, pointer tier) — standalone W3C DTCG 2025.10 tokens.

decelerate.$description: WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 Direct Entrance decelerate curve.

accelerate.$description: WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 Gentle Exit accelerate curve.

caption.$description: Small captions and segmented counter labels.

detail.$description: Sidebar section labels, counts, and supporting metadata.

body.$description: Standard body copy, list rows, and dialog content.

label.$description: Control labels, form labels, and interactive triggers.

display.$description: Large display numerals and hero headings.

dimension.$description: Desktop pointer layout density, control geometry, and icon sizes.

shape.$description: Semantic corner radius roles referencing base dimension.radius.* tokens.

control.$description: Corner radius for buttons, select triggers, tabs, and menu items.

field.$description: Corner radius for text inputs and editor wells.

chip.$description: Corner radius for badges and chips.

card.$description: Corner radius for cards and sidebar overlays.

overlay.$description: Corner radius for menus, popovers, and toasts.

sheet.$description: Corner radius for drawers and bottom sheets.

inset.$description: Corner radius for inset wells, alerts, and skeletons inside cards.

hairline.$description: Hairline divider and outlined-variant stroke width.

surface.$description: 0px surface outline (M3 elevated/filled surfaces rely on elevation rather than outlines).

indicator.$description: 3px active tab/navigation indicator width per M3.

focus.$description: M3 focus indicator: 3px solid outline offset 2px (_md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss).

offset.$description: 2px outward focus indicator offset per M3.

radius.$description: Material 3 Expressive corner scale (999px CornerFull controls, 4px CornerExtraSmall fields/menus, 12px CornerMedium cards/chips, 28px CornerExtraLarge dialogs/sheets; ShapeTokens.kt).

base.$description: Base corner radius shared by insets and general rounded elements.

card.$description: Corner radius for cards and sidebar floating containers.

control.$description: Corner radius for interactive controls such as buttons, triggers, and menu items.

field.$description: Corner radius for form input fields and editor wells.

chip.$description: Corner radius for badges, chips, and compact tags.

overlay.$description: Corner radius for floating menus, popovers, and toasts.

sheet.$description: Corner radius for drawers and bottom sheets.

size.$description: Ergonomic sizing scales for pointer input.

hit.$description: Minimum hit target size (0 disables padding expansion).

density.$description: Page-level row, padding, gap, and surface spacing metrics.

control.$description: Control internal geometry and switch size tier.

shape.$description: M3 circular arc corners with top-only rounded corners on filled text fields (FilledTextFieldTokens.kt).

state.$description: Interaction state opacities, press scale, and ripple switch.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking; M3 uses state layer + Android ripple).

overlay.$description: M3 state-layer ink opacities: hover 0.08, focus 0.10, pressed 0.10, dragged 0.16 (StateTokens.kt).

pressed-opacity.$description: Content stays full opacity when pressed (1; ripple/state layer shows press).

disabled.$description: M3 disabled opacities: 0.38 content and 0.10 container (_md-comp-button-filled.scss).

motion.$description: Interactive spring and timing physics roles.

press.$description: M3 Expressive FastSpatial spring (stiffness 800, damping ratio 0.6; ExpressiveMotionTokens.kt).

settle.$description: M3 Expressive DefaultSpatial spring (stiffness 380, damping ratio 0.8).

control.$description: M3 Expressive DefaultEffects spring (stiffness 1600, damping ratio 1.0).

move.$description: M3 Expressive DefaultSpatial spring for layout and indicator movement.

indicator.$description: M3 underlined tabs and filled-text-field underline indicator.

mono.$description: Monospace font family for code blocks and numeric readouts.

size.$description: Font sizes per type role for pointer input.

line-height.$description: Unitless line-height ratios per type role for pointer input.

color.$description: Adaptive A-layer and B-layer color roles for dark appearance.

brand-fill.$description: Primary brand action fill, aliased to {color.primary}.

on-brand.$description: Foreground text and icons on brand-fill surfaces, aliased to {color.primary-foreground}.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (M3 scrim at 32% opacity).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

chart-foreground.$description: Dark ink on light chart tiles matching M3 light onSurface.

window-close.$description: macOS window close traffic-light fill mapped to M3 light error.

window-minimize.$description: macOS window minimize traffic-light fill mapped to NSH light warn.

window-zoom.$description: macOS window zoom traffic-light fill mapped to NSH light up.

window-control-ink.$description: Glyph ink inside macOS window traffic-light buttons.

window-control-edge.$description: Hairline border around macOS window traffic-light buttons.

background.$description: Primary page surface (M3 surface role, material-web v34.0.21).

foreground.$description: Default text and icon ink on surfaces (M3 onSurface).

popover.$description: Floating popover and menu container background (M3 surfaceContainer).

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on primary fills (M3 onPrimary).

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary supporting text and icon ink (M3 onSurfaceVariant).

destructive.$description: Error and destructive action color (M3 error).

scrollbar-thumb-hover.$description: Scrollbar thumb fill on pointer hover.

hover.$description: M3 hover state-layer ink (8% foreground over transparent, StateTokens.kt).

ring-halo.$description: Outer focus ring halo (20% ring color over transparent).

brand.$description: Inline brand accent ink, aliased to {color.primary}.

track.$description: Switch and slider track fill (M3 surfaceContainerHighest).

code.$description: Monospace code text ink inside recessed wells.

info.$description: Informational semantic color matching M3 primary.

up.$description: Positive trend and growth semantic color.

on-brand-tint.$description: Ink on selected chip/tile fills (M3 Expressive onSecondaryContainer).

inverse.$description: Inverse surface for snackbars and tooltips (M3 inverseSurface).

inverse-muted.$description: Supporting text and close icon on inverse snackbars, aliased to {color.inverse-foreground} (Compose SnackbarTokens.kt).

inverse-brand.$description: Brand action ink on inverse surfaces (M3 inversePrimary).

info-tint.$description: Translucent informational wash (12% info over transparent).

warn-tint.$description: Translucent warning wash (12% warn over transparent).

up-tint.$description: Translucent positive wash (12% up over transparent).

down-tint.$description: Translucent negative wash (12% down over transparent).

card-foreground.$description: Primary text and icon ink on card surfaces.

popover-foreground.$description: Primary text and icon ink on popover surfaces.

accent-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on accent fills (M3 Expressive onSecondaryContainer).

secondary-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on secondary containers (M3 Expressive onSecondaryContainer, Tone 30 in light).

sidebar-foreground.$description: Primary text and icon ink inside the sidebar.

sidebar-accent-foreground.$description: Sidebar active item text ink (M3 Expressive onSecondaryContainer).

sidebar-primary.$description: Primary action highlight color in the sidebar.

sidebar-primary-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on sidebar-primary highlights.

sidebar-ring.$description: Focus indicator ring color inside the sidebar.

down.$description: Negative trend and decline semantic color.

finish.$description: Appearance-invariant surface finish recipes (background, gradient, border, shadow, blur, material).

card.$description: Elevated M3 card surface with Material Web Level 1 shadow and 1dp Android elevation.

inset.$description: The well inside a card: sunk by its inner shadow alone.

field.$description: A field well: its edge and its inner shadow.

raised.$description: Raised surface with Level 1 shadow and 1dp Android elevation.

hover.$description: Hovered state surface over raised background with Level 1 shadow.

pressed.$description: Pressed surface at Level 1 elevation (M3 state layer + ripple handles press).

light.$description: The main action brightest step: the accent gradient.

accent.$description: The accent face (the same as light).

track.$description: A groove: an inner shadow and an edge.

fill.$description: The filled run: a slider, a progress bar, a switch that is on.

handle.$description: A slider handle (kept apart from knob).

pill.$description: The upstream capsule, left to the app.

thumb.$description: The chosen segment of a segmented control or a tag.

on.$description: A chosen switch or box, and the mark on it.

chip.$description: A chosen value label inside a field: a fill, an inner highlight and an edge.

glass.$description: Floating surface using opaque M3 popover with Level 2 shadow and 3dp elevation (M3 uses no blur).

menu.$description: M3 menu/popover surface with Level 2 shadow and 3dp Android elevation.

dialog.$description: M3 dialog surface with Level 3 shadow and 6dp Android elevation.

tooltip.$description: M3 plain tooltip using inverse surface without shadow.

inverse.$description: M3 snackbar/inverse surface with Level 3 shadow and 6dp Android elevation.

groove.$description: A groove cut inside a menu.
